diagram_review.scope: Reviewed every assigned ItemBody and title against its frozen snapshot, rendered HTML and each original screenshot tile. Checked LaTeX/MathMarkdown, raw ASCII math, reference rendering, clipping, expected technique banners, and source-supported diagrams.

displayed_diagram_checks.check: For A=E({p})={p,q}, B={q,r}, C={r}, Z=∅, table entries agree with the stated ε-NFA: A·a=B, A·b=Z, B·a=B, B·b=C, C·a=Z, C·b=C, and Z is absorbing. The accepting reachable subsets are B and C because exactly those contain r.

missing_diagram_candidates.content: Draw the finite array with time rows t=0,…,T and tape columns j=0,…,W−1; mark the unique head cell by (q,a), show the blank unmarked right endpoint, and show one interior update from the old three-cell window (a,b,c) to the new centre symbol d in row t+1.
missing_diagram_candidates.checks: Source lines 25–29 explicitly set W=T+2 and the row/column index ranges; define marked symbols (q,a), the unique head and blank last cell; and specify the local relation R_j(a,b,c,d) from three old symbols to the new centre symbol, with boundary cases at j=0 and W−1. The frozen screenshot contains the full prose/formula but no existing figure.
missing_diagram_candidates.reason: This construction is a central time-space array encoding, and the exact local dependency (three adjacent cells in one row determine a centre cell in the next) is easier to see in a small schematic. The drawing should be labeled as a local window and should not claim to prove tableau correctness; the item’s text and proof remain authoritative.
missing_diagram_candidates.uncertain: A conceptual aid only; not needed for correctness and no mathematical defect is alleged.

diagram_review.notes: No assigned capture receipt reports a TikZ figure or diagram failure. No raw TikZ/TeX was visible in the original tiles. Titles and ordinary reference links render; reference links appear as block lines as expected. Technique banners are the expected CSS uppercase style. No confirmed clipping was observed in standalone original tiles. No optional typography observation is recorded.
